<!--more-->

In public institutions it seems quite common that the management receives so-called *dashboards*, which contain a series of indicators and serve as background information.

```{r, message=FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(eurostat)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(zoo)
```

### Data

The `eurostat` package comes with a list of euro area countries. This is very useful when you only want to download data for euro area countries.

### Gross domestic product

```{r}
raw <- get_eurostat(id = "namq_10_gdp", filters = list(geo = "AT",
                                                       na_item = c("B1GQ", "P3_S13", "P31_S14_S15", "P5G", "P6", "P7"),
                                                       unit = c("CP_MNAC", "CLV15_MEUR"),
                                                       s_adj = c("SCA")))
temp <- raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(values)) %>%
  select(time, unit, na_item, values) %>%
  arrange(time, unit, na_item) %>%
  group_by(unit, na_item) %>%
  mutate(values = values / 1000,
         growth = values / lag(values, 4) - 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(date = as.yearqtr(time, "%Y-Q%q"))

# Nominal
nominal <- temp %>%
  filter(date >= "2015 Q1") %>%
  filter(unit == "CP_MNAC") %>%
  select(date, na_item, values) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "na_item", values_from = "values") %>%
  mutate(PX = B1GQ - (P3_S13 + P31_S14_S15 + P5G + P6 - P7))

nominal_col <- nominal %>%
  select(-B1GQ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c("date")) %>%
  mutate(value = ifelse(name == "P7", -value, value))

nominal_line <- nominal %>%
  select(date, B1GQ)

g_temp <- ggplot(nominal_col, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = value, fill = name)) +
  geom_line(data = nominal_line, aes(y = B1GQ)) +
  labs(title = "Nominelles BIP",
       subtitle = "Mrd EUR")

g_temp
```

```{r}
table <- nominal %>%
  select(-PX) %>%
  tail(5)

table
```


### Real GDP growth

```{r, message = FALSE}
real <- temp %>%
  filter(unit == "CLV15_MEUR") %>%
  select(date, na_item, values) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "na_item", values_from = "values") %>%
  mutate(PNX = P6 - P7) %>%
  select(-P6, -P7) %>%
  mutate(PX = B1GQ - (P3_S13 + P31_S14_S15 + P5G + PNX),
         P3_S13 = P3_S13 - lag(P3_S13, 4),
         P31_S14_S15 = P31_S14_S15 - lag(P31_S14_S15, 4),
         P5G = P5G - lag(P5G, 4),
         PNX = PNX - lag(PNX, 4),
         PX = PX - lag(PX, 4),
         P3_S13 = P3_S13 / lag(B1GQ, 4),
         P31_S14_S15 = P31_S14_S15 / lag(B1GQ, 4),
         P5G = P5G / lag(B1GQ, 4),
         PNX = PNX / lag(B1GQ, 4),
         PX = PX / lag(B1GQ, 4)) %>%
  select(-B1GQ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c("date")) %>%
  filter(date >= "2015 Q1") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value))

real_agg <- temp %>%
  filter(unit == "CLV15_MEUR",
         na_item == "B1GQ") %>%
  mutate(values = values / lag(values, 4) - 1) %>%
  filter(date >= "2015 Q1") %>%
  filter(!is.na(values)) %>%
  rename(value = values)

ggplot(real, aes(x = date, y = value)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = name)) +
  geom_line(data = real_agg)
```
